entities.name: Operator-defined access category definitions
entities.description: An information element used to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE or delete existing operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The user equipment that receives and processes the operator-defined access category definitions.

entities.name: Assign new operator-defined access category definitions
entities.description: Condition where the IE is included to assign new operator-defined access category definitions to the UE.

entities.name: Delete operator-defined access category definitions
entities.description: Condition where the IE is included to delete existing operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.

relations.description: The IE may be included under the condition to assign new operator-defined access category definitions.
The IE may be included under the condition to delete existing operator-defined access category definitions.
When the IE is included to assign new definitions, it establishes new operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.
When the IE is included to delete definitions, it establishes the deletion of operator-defined access category definitions at the UE.
